english.title: Sing / dance / shout / play a musical instrument / erect apparatus for that purpose at Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[sang]_
(B)_[danced]_
(C)_[shouted]_
(D)_[played a musical instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTRUMENT..),]_
(E)_[erected or used apparatus for the transmission, receipt, recording, reproduction or amplification of sound, speech or images, namely **(..SPECIFY THE APPARATUS..),]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Luton Airport having been ordered to cease that activity by an airport official
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 2.14 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
